sources.title: The 8B Parameter Reality Check: When to Use Small Models and When to ...
sources.snippet: At West AI Labs, we deploy a lot of local AI infrastructure. We spend a significant amount of time deciding which workloads belong on an 8B local model and which need something bigger. After running these systems in production, here is what we have learned. The reality of the 8B parameter limit is not just about VRAM.
